paper.citation: Tchetgen Tchetgen, E. J. and Shpitser, I. (2012). Semiparametric theory for causal mediation analysis: efficiency bounds, multiple robustness and sensitivity analysis. The Annals of Statistics 40(3), 1816–1845. DOI: 10.1214/12-AOS990.
paper.source_locator: Section 3, electronic-reprint PDF page 13: Model.X, Model.E, Model.M, Model.Y. NIE definition: equation (1), PDF page 2.

mechanism.name: Natural indirect effect in the Tchetgen Tchetgen–Shpitser mediation design

generation_equations.label: Outcome
generation_equations.expression: Y = 1 + 0.2 X1 + 0.3 X2 + 1.4 X3 - 2.5 A - 3.5 M + 5 A M + epsilon; epsilon ~ Normal(0,1)

assumptions: Mediator–outcome exchangeability conditional on A,X and the required cross-world condition
No treatment-induced mediator–outcome confounder in this simple natural-effect design
Treatment and mediator positivity on the declared support; tail overlap may still be poor in finite samples

properties.notes: X1*X3 in treatment/mediator logits; A*M in the outcome. Nonlinearity is the logistic link, not a nonlinear continuous outcome surface. X variables are dependent. All three baseline covariates affect the mechanism.

estimand.name: theta_NIE = theta_11 - theta_10
estimand.definition: E[Y(1,M(1)) - Y(1,M(0))] in the superpopulation defined by the fixed DGP.

truth.expression: E[Y(1,M(1)) - Y(1,M(0))] in the superpopulation defined by the fixed DGP.
truth.derivation: Enumerate X1,X2 and use 64/128-point Gauss–Hermite quadrature for conditional Gaussian X3; independently compare composite Simpson integration.

adaptations: Keep the Section 3 observed-data equations and fixed parameters unchanged; rename exposure E to A.
Evaluate NIE = theta_11 - theta_10, whereas the Section 3 simulation compares natural direct-effect estimators.
Use small CPU checks instead of reproducing the paper's entire n=600/1000, R=1000 simulation or any PFN experiment.

Promote the existing student-toolkit example to contributions; generator.py, truth.py, verify.py and config.json are copied unchanged. This is an existing example-family registration, not a newly discovered mechanism.
